name: random_joke
description: Fetch one random dad joke from icanhazdadjoke.com. Returns joke text and alphanumeric ID.

name: search_jokes
description: Search dad jokes by keyword or topic. Returns matching jokes with IDs and text.

name: get_joke
description: Retrieve a specific dad joke by ID. Returns the full joke text.

id.description: The ID of the dad joke to retrieve.
